import sys

def main():
    R, C = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    if R > C:
        R, C = C, R
    full = (1 << R) - 1
    INF = 69
    size = 1 << R
    # rolling DP: prev[mask1][mask2], cur[mask2][mask3]
    prev = [[INF] * size for _ in range(size)]
    cur = [[INF] * size for _ in range(size)]
    # base: dp[0][0][mask] = 0
    for mask in range(size):
        prev[0][mask] = 0
    for c in range(1, C + 1):
        # reset cur
        for i in range(size):
            cur[i] = [INF] * size
        for mask2 in range(size):
            for mask3 in range(size):
                best = INF
                for mask1 in range(size):
                    if prev[mask1][mask2] == INF:
                        continue
                    # check validity condition using bitwise operations
                    # cover: left neighbor (mask2 << 1), right neighbor (mask2 >> 1), mask1, mask3
                    cover = ((mask2 << 1) & full) | (mask2 >> 1) | mask1 | mask3
                    zeros = (~mask2) & full
                    if (zeros & ~cover) == 0:
                        val = prev[mask1][mask2] + bin(mask1).count('1')
                        if val < best:
                            best = val
                cur[mask2][mask3] = best
        # swap
        prev, cur = cur, prev
    res = 0
    for mask in range(size):
        val = prev[mask][0]  # dp[C][mask][0]
        if val == INF:
            continue
        res = max(res, R * C - (val + bin(mask).count('1')))
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
